To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

cells of the dorsal margin of early gastrula zebrafish embryos are specified to form notochord, tail mesoderm and Kupffer's vesicles, and that the notochord and tail mesoderm are specified by flh and ntl, respectively, whereas Kupffer's vesicular fate is not controlled by either gene.

1) the notochord and tailbud mesoderm are derived from adjacent regions of the early gastrula; 2) the border between these domains is defined by the expression domain of flh and the fate map domain of ntl; and 3) cells in the notochondral fate map domain can generate the epithelial lining that forms Kupffer's vesicles in the wild-type embryo.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the specification and differentiation of the notochod, a structure that is essential for the body axis of vertebrates.
specification of cell fates during the early gastrula stage of zebrafish, and the role of the homeobox genes flh and ntl in this process.
the analysis of the mechanisms underlying the formation and function of the zebfish gastrula organizer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the notochord cells are generated from a domain of the dorsal blastodermal margin that expresses flh.
the notochord and tail mesoderm fates are specified by the dorsal midline cells of the early gastrula, whereas the fate of the forrunner cells is not yet specified.
the dorsal marginal zone of the zebfish gastrula contains cells with the potential to form notochord, tail mesoderm or Kupffer's vesicles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dorsal marginal region contains a domain of cells with a restricted fate, the notochord, which is specified by the early gastrula expression pattern of flh.
cells in the noto-chord domain of the dorsal margin are specified as notochord cells, whereas the forerun-ner cells are specified as tail mesoderm.
the dorsal marginal cells in the early gastrulating zebrafish embryo have a broad potential to form notochord, tail mesoderm or forerunners.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cells of the early gastrula are specified to particular fates, and that these fates are not necessarily fixed, as cells can relocate to new locations in order to express new fates.
the fate map of the dorsal marginal zone is highly restricted, and that the fate of a cell is determined by its position within this fate map.
the dorsal marginal region is composed of a mosaic of cells that are specified for distinct fates.
